answer: Sybil resistance requires economic weight. New agents stake tokens on the ledger ledge for 30 days before governance rights. The network observes behavioral fingerprints: coordinated timing, shared metadata, simultaneous terrace access. Suspicious clusters trigger slashing and permanent revocation. Each sybil costs real stake and time, making mass attacks economically irrational — especially when combined with geological proofs tied to physical shale infrastructure that software cannot fake.
